lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: Shall we go over the accounts, ferryman? Best to settle what you owe me now, so we don't end up arguing about it later.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Let's go over the accounts, Hermes. Always best to agree on a figure. Saves trouble.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: One anchor, as requested. Five drachmas.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: I swear by Hades, I paid five for it. And an oar-strap: two obols.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Put down five drachmas, two obols.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: And a darning needle for the sail. I paid five obols for that.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: And wax to patch the leaks in the skiff, plus nails, and a bit of rope you used for the brace. Two drachmas for the lot.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: I think that's everything, unless we've forgotten something. So. When do you plan to pay me back?

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Right now, Hermes? Impossible. But if a plague or a war sends down a massive batch all at once, I'll be able to turn a profit by overcharging on the fares.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: So I just have to sit here praying for the absolute worst to happen, just to get my expenses back?

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: There's no other way, Hermes. Business is slow right now, as you can see. It's peacetime.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: I suppose peace is for the best, even if it means you stringing out my repayment. But still, Charon... you remember the old days. You know the sort of men who used to come down here. All of them brave, covered in blood, mostly wounded in battle. Now it's a man poisoned by his son or his wife, or totally bloated in the gut and legs from sheer luxury. They're all pale, pathetic, nothing like the old crowd. And most of them seem to end up here because they're murdering each other over money.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Well, money is very much in demand.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: Exactly. So you can hardly blame me for wanting what I'm owed.
